author: marioevz
content:
I've been vibe-coding https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12616 into the specs to better understand what the end-state of an Ethereum fork that implements it would look like: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3957

I also made a high-level explainer of what works and what doesn't if we decide to go with the current bogota-devnet-2 + https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12616 for Hegota.

Explainer link here: https://marioevz.github.io/specs-pq-status/

<@427491045308235776> I reference your `pq-chain-analysis` in several places in the explainer, so this might be interesting to you.
